statements.t: • Korea includes WEBTOON Korea, NAVER SERIES, and Munpia where our content is in Korean and targeted at Korean speaking users.
• Japan includes LINE MANGA and eBookJapan where our content is in Japanese and targeted at Japanese speaking users.
• Rest of World includes WEBTOON in all other languages including English, Spanish, and more, as well as Wattpad, where our content is targeted at global users outside of Korea and Japan.
We estimate that foreign exchange fluctuations had a total negative impact of approximately $49.3 million on our reported revenue for the nine months ended September 30, 2026.
Our presentation of Adjusted EBITDA and Adjusted EBITDA Margin should not be construed as an inference that our future results will be unaffected by unusual or non-recurring items.
There can be no assurance that we will not modify the presentation of these measures in the future, and any such modification may be material.

Under the RI Games Shareholders Agreement, following the second closing and through June 30, 2030, we may be required to fund capital increases of RI Games Holdings of up to KRW 50 billion (approximately $36.8 million) in cash, and if specified revenue targets are achieved, to fund a further capital increase up to a specified maximum and to purchase the Seller’s remaining 6,000 shares for not less than KRW 100…
Our expected primary uses of capital are acquisitions and strategic investments, repayment of debt, working capital, capital expenditures, geographic expansion and other general corporate purposes.
In addition, during the three months ended September 30, 2026, we capitalized $0.3 million of internal-use software development costs related to the Wattpad re-platforming project.
